name: Distigmine bromide
summary: Distigmine (as distigmine bromide) is a parasympathomimetic. Distigmine is similar to pyridostigmine and neostigmine but has a longer duration of action. It is available as tablets on prescription only. It is commonly used to treat various conditions, including myasthenia gravis and underactive bladder.

uses.text: It is commonly used to treat various conditions, including myasthenia gravis and underactive bladder. Distigmine has a greater risk of causing cholinergic crisis because of accumulation of the drug being more likely than with neostigmine or pyridostigmine and so distigmine is rarely used as a treatment for myasthenia gravis, unlike pyridostigmine and neostigmine.

pharmacology.en: It blocks acetylcholinesterase, the enzyme that breaks down acetylcholine. With more acetylcholine at nerve endings, muscles contract more strongly and the bladder empties more easily.
pharmacology.zh: 它會抑制乙醯膽鹼酯酶，也就是分解乙醯膽鹼的酵素。神經末梢的乙醯膽鹼增加後，肌肉收縮更有力，膀胱也更容易排空。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会抑制乙酰胆碱酯酶，也就是分解乙酰胆碱的酵素。神经末梢的乙酰胆碱增加后，肌肉收缩更有力，膀胱也更容易排空。

sideEffects.en: Common effects are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, stomach cramps, sweating, extra saliva and a slow heart rate. Because it can build up in the body, it carries a real risk of cholinergic crisis, with severe weakness and breathing failure, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 常見反應有噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、腹部絞痛、出汗、唾液增加與心跳變慢。由於它可能在體內累積，確實有引發膽鹼危象的風險，會出現嚴重無力與呼吸衰竭，可能危及生命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见反应有恶心、呕吐、腹泻、腹部绞痛、出汗、唾液增加与心跳变慢。由于它可能在体内累积，确实有引发胆碱危象的风险，会出现严重无力与呼吸衰竭，可能危及生命。

fact.en: Its molecule is like two pyridostigmine units joined by a long carbon chain, which helps explain why its effect lasts longer than that of its relatives.
fact.zh: 它的分子就像兩個吡啶斯的明單元以一條長碳鏈連在一起，這也有助於解釋為何它的作用比同類藥物更持久。
fact.zhHans: 它的分子就像两个吡啶斯的明单元以一条长碳链连在一起，这也有助于解释为何它的作用比同类药物更持久。
